source_title: The Effect of Combined Atmospheric Plasma/UV Treatments on Improving the Durability of Flame Retardants Applied to Cotton
source_location: Methods §4.7; Table 8 thermal analysis; Table 9 LOI
evidence: Open-access full article. TGA: 30–700 °C, 10 °C/min in air (110 mL/min). Table 8 gives sample-state-resolved T10, DTG peaks and R400 before/after water soaking; Table 9 gives LOI for the corresponding unsoaked/water-soaked states.
limitations: Only states with an exact LOI in Table 9 and a matching TGA row in Table 8 are included. Sample-code punctuation/spacing is normalized only where the two tables clearly refer to the same named treatment.
